decision: Komodo has no merchant dish photos online (no delivery platform listing found; Google Maps shows only unlabelled customer photos). Following the user's approved practice for Logan Corner, Juvian's and Toy Sun, labelled Wikimedia Commons photos of similar dishes illustrate the menu. Most files are reused from the Toy Sun package; mapo tofu and wonton noodle soup are new picks.
labelling: Each illustrated dish description ends with "Illustrative photo, not from this restaurant: <author>, <licence>, Wikimedia Commons." and the image alt text ends with "(illustrative photo)".
rejected: File:Fried mushrooms.jpg (D.L., CC BY-SA 2.0) for 7b Deep Fried Mushrooms: shot in a chain restaurant basket with its branded paper.
File:Wonton Noodle Soup in Fresno, California (...).jpg (NeoBatfreak) for 11 Wonton Noodle Soup: chili-oil broth would suggest a spicy dish the menu does not mark.
File:Wonton egg noodle soup.jpg (T.Tseng): mostly greens and wontons, noodles barely visible.

No photo for satay, honey garlic, black bean (shrimp, ribs, tofu), mixed greens, Komodo Specials, Golden Dragon, Dai Dop Voy, Soo Guy with pineapple, Chinese perogies, crab rolls, battered/breaded shrimp and family dinners: no honest match in the vetted set.
